title: Refraction into water, and back out
caption: Entering water at 50°, light bends towards the normal: sin r = sin 50° / 1.33, so r = 35.2°. Going the other way, from water to air, any ray beyond the critical angle 48.8° is totally internally reflected.
alt: Three ray diagrams: air to water at 50 degrees refracting to 35.2 degrees; water to air at 30 degrees refracting away from the normal; water to air at 60 degrees totally internally reflected.
description: Water to air at 30°: the ray bends away from the normal, to 41.7°.
Critical angle sin⁻¹(1/1.33) = 48.8°; at 60° the ray cannot leave and reflects totally.
